_doc: The 10 mm slot of Motedis' B-type profiles (40 mm series). Motedis prints the opening and the depth; it sells the section as B-type, made to match Bosch Rexroth's 10 mm slot, so the lip, the cavity's width and the floor are Rexroth's figures (slot-10-bosch), marked community until someone measures a Motedis bar.
name: slot-10-motedis

opening.rule: Slot width, "10" on the data picture ("Nuten mit einer Breite von 10 mm" where the page says so)
opening.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-40x40-B-Typ-Nut-10", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-40x40-B-Typ-Nut-10

lip_thickness.rule: Lip thickness: Motedis prints none. Rexroth's figure for the slot this is made to match (slot-10-bosch)
lip_thickness.source: slot-10-bosch rule set; Motedis calls the section B-type

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: Motedis prints none. Rexroth's figure (slot-10-bosch)
cavity_width.source: slot-10-bosch rule set; Motedis calls the section B-type

cavity_depth.rule: Slot depth, "12,5" on the data picture
cavity_depth.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-40x40-B-Typ-Nut-10", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-40x40-B-Typ-Nut-10

floor_width.rule: Width of the flat floor: as slot-10-bosch, itself scaled off Rexroth's drawing
floor_width.source: slot-10-bosch rule set; Motedis calls the section B-type

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as slot-10-bosch
flank_angle.source: slot-10-bosch rule set; Motedis calls the section B-type

nut_family.rule: Sold as B-type: it takes nuts made for Bosch Rexroth's 10 mm slot
nut_family.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-40x40-B-Typ-Nut-10", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-40x40-B-Typ-Nut-10
